constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a domain for the curve associated to a hatching.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a semi-infinite domain for the curve associated to a hatching. The `First' flag means that the given point is the first one.

instanceMethods.name: SetPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the first and the second points of the domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the first and the second points of the domain as the infinite.

instanceMethods.name: SetFirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the first point of the domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetFirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the first point of the domain at the infinite.

instanceMethods.name: SetSecondPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the second point of the domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetSecondPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the second point of the domain at the infinite.

instanceMethods.name: HasFirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the domain has a first point.

instanceMethods.name: FirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: HasSecondPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the domain has a second point.

instanceMethods.name: SecondPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the second point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasSecondPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Dump of the domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetIndex
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the index of the supporting curve.

instanceMethods.name: Index
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the index of the supporting curve.

instanceMethods.name: SetParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the parameter on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: Parameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the position of the point on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: Position
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the position of the point on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: SetStateBefore
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the transition state before the intersection.

instanceMethods.name: StateBefore
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the transition state before the intersection.

instanceMethods.name: SetStateAfter
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the transition state after the intersection.

instanceMethods.name: StateAfter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the transition state after of the intersection.

instanceMethods.name: SetSegmentBeginning
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the flag that the point is the beginning of a segment.

instanceMethods.name: SegmentBeginning
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the flag that the point is the beginning of a segment.

instanceMethods.name: SetSegmentEnd
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the flag that the point is the end of a segment.

instanceMethods.name: SegmentEnd
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the flag that the point is the end of a segment.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Dump of the point on element.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: --Purpose; Creates an empty point on element

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a point from an intersection point.

instanceMethods.name: SetIntersectionType
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the intersection type at this point.

instanceMethods.name: IntersectionType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the intersection type at this point.

instanceMethods.name: IsIdentical
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if the point is identical to an other. That is to say : P1.myIndex = P2.myIndex Abs (P1.myParam - P2.myParam) <= Confusion P1.myPosit = P2.myPosit P1.myBefore = P2.myBefore P1.myAfter = P2.myAfter P1.mySegBeg = P2.mySegBeg P1.mySegEnd = P2.mySegEnd P1.myType = P2.myType.

instanceMethods.name: IsDifferent
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if the point is different from an other.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Dump of the point on element.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a point from an intersection point.

instanceMethods.name: AddPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a point on element to the point.

instanceMethods.name: NbPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of elements intersecting the hatching at this point.

instanceMethods.name: Point
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Index-th point on element of the point. The exception OutOfRange is raised if Index > NbPoints.

instanceMethods.name: RemPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the Index-th point on element of the point. The exception OutOfRange is raised if Index > NbPoints.

instanceMethods.name: ClrPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Removes all the points on element of the point.

instanceMethods.name: IsLower
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if the point is lower than an other. A point on hatching P1 is said to be lower than an other P2 if : P2.myParam - P1.myParam > Confusion.

instanceMethods.name: IsEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if the point is equal to an other. A point on hatching P1 is said to be equal to an other P2 if : | P2.myParam - P1.myParam | <= Confusion.

instanceMethods.name: IsGreater
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if the point is greater than an other. A point on hatching P1 is said to be greater than an other P2 if : P1.myParam - P2.myParam > Confusion.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Dump of the point.
